column1: # host/i18n/core.tsv: host texts of the HTTP/API envelopes of runtime.rs and the service dispatcher in services/mod.rs.
# Columns: key<TAB>nl<TAB>en, exactly one tab each, UTF-8, LF. Escapes: \n \t \\ only. Placeholders {name}
# (ASCII letters, digits, _). Plurals: key.one / key.other (optional key.zero); one when the count is exactly 1.
# The first key segment is the file stem. nl is G's own 3b898e6 literal byte for byte (never H's); en is en-GB in
# Windows 11 wording (tools/i18n/glossary.tsv), taken from H only when H's nl is byte-identical.
# Rows are written by tools/i18n/extract_rs.py, never by hand. Lines starting with # are comments; translator
# context goes directly above its row. "#@ <path> <ordinal> <sha256[:16]> <fmt|plain|en|enfmt> [<spec>=<name> ...]"
# and "#@ new" lines are machine records of the 3b898e6 literal a row replaced (en/enfmt: the English half of a
# former inline pair) or of new Dutch text; tools/i18n/drift_rust.py checks them.
# Checked by: python3 -B tools/i18n/check_rust.py and python3 -B tools/i18n/drift_rust.py (notes/claude/round2-gate.md).
# new(): ApiError "offline": a call arrived after this window's services shut down
# serve(): ApiError "forbidden": HTTP 403: a request from another origin
# serve(): ApiError "bad_request": HTTP 400: bad method name; also a body that is no JSON object
# serve(): ApiError "length_required": HTTP 411: chunked request body
# serve(): ApiError "too_large": HTTP 413: a body over 16 MiB
# proxy(): ApiError "offline": HTTP 502: the Python reference service (WIN11_REFERENCE_INSTANCE, tests only) did not answer; {error} is the transport error
# events(): the same, as the plain-text body of the /api/events 502
# unknown(): ApiError "unknown_method": a method name nobody handles
# call(): ApiError "offline": a call before this window's dispatcher is connected (start-up)
# native_app(): one line on stderr, then exit 127: the native GTK 4 app win11-gtk-<kind> is not next to the host
# binaries, and there is no other app to start; also portal.rs (picker.rs show_native) for a missing
# win11-gtk-explorer. {path} is the full path of the missing binary
